rationale: The strongest frozen table model currently receives every feature as a category. Some anonymous columns consistently express quantities. Test whether numerical input types and more independent preprocessing views help the same transformer. This changes what the encoder consumes rather than adding another voting model blindly.
design: Freeze TabICLv2 2.0.3 and the same verified checkpoint, train only on the established 4061 fitting rows, and use four native four-view ensembles with seeds 173, 683, 1607 and 3091. Compare raw sixteen-view average to a typed four-view and typed sixteen-view average. Reuse the exact existing raw four-view seed-173 probabilities. Provision seven new classifier contexts for 28 new internal views. For typed input infer numeric, comparable interval, clock or duration fields using the training-only shared parser. Replace only recognized fields with floats, encode clocks cyclically as additional features, retain all other categorical fields and allow unknown quantities to be missing.
decision: Bind outputs for all three reused development panels before the 808-row nomination, allow retain, standalone, and .125/.25/.5 shares of each candidate with the current reference pair. Freeze the choice and compare net change on both 817/807 panels; at least .003 pooled plus no decline on either to advance to a new ordinary-entry study. Record all seven actual fits separately from internal views. No official validation, test, external labels or language-model API.
